background: Commonwealth Bank of Australia is the largest of Australia's big four banks and the country's largest mortgage lender, funded mainly by Australian retail deposits, with a New Zealand subsidiary in ASB.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA on average with the weakest at AA-, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 5 Mar 2026. Against Australian banks the figures sit close to the middle: CET1 of 12.0% is just above the median and NSFR of 115% in the top quarter, while leverage of 4.6% and LCR of 132% are below the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026, so the strength here rests mainly on the ratings.
